description: Support issue taxonomy used by the ticket-analysis package to classify synthetic support conversations. Draft: not independently reviewed, not a gold label set, not a measurement of any production system, and not any company’s support policy.
contents: Definitions only. No customer messages, ticket identifiers, names, contact details, credentials, volumes, or response metrics.
metadataInterpretation: Owner, priority, fix home, automation tier, maximum automation scope, and protected mutation flag are provisional triage metadata, never permission for a protected action.

classificationPrinciples.primaryL2: Select by the current central unresolved customer need; do not substitute severity, earliest topic, or first matching keyword.
classificationPrinciples.secondaryL2: At most one independently expressed additional need; never count keyword co-occurrence as verified multi-issue.
classificationPrinciples.subjectBody: Body/current customer turn has priority; subject supplies missing detail and breaks unresolved ties. Explicit conflict favors body and should be noted.
classificationPrinciples.riskFlags: Assess regardless of primary/secondary L2; high-risk handling independent of label confidence.
classificationPrinciples.l3: Confirmed cause needs independent evidence; customer assertions alone are insufficient.
classificationPrinciples.rootCause: Default fix home is a hypothesis; confirm with diagnosis and trusted system evidence.
classificationPrinciples.protectedMutation: Neither automation tier nor maximum scope approves money, credits, account/access/entitlement or data mutations. This project has no action executor.
classificationPrinciples.quality: Evaluate exact-primary and acceptable-alternate agreement separately; independently score flag precision/recall against adjudicated synthetic labels. Abstain when unsupported.

l2Issues.name: Refund request (money)
l2Issues.definition: Customer asks for money back for a payment.
l2Issues.useWhen: The ask is a refund of a charge: a renewal they meant to cancel, an accidental purchase or upgrade, a service failure.
l2Issues.notThis: Credits back for failed or disappointing generations go to CRD-01 or CRD-05. A charge after cancelling goes to BIL-02.

l2Issues.name: Unexpected or duplicate charge
l2Issues.definition: Customer sees a charge they do not expect.
l2Issues.useWhen: Two charges, a charge after cancelling, an unfamiliar charge, or a pending hold read as a charge.
l2Issues.notThis: They understand the charge and want it refunded: BIL-01.

l2Issues.name: Cancellation & subscription management
l2Issues.definition: Customer wants to cancel, pause, or find the cancel control.
l2Issues.useWhen: How to cancel, cancel before renewal, cancel a trial, pause a plan.
l2Issues.notThis: Pricing opinion sent after cancelling goes to PLN-01 with flag F-CHURN. A refund of the last charge goes to BIL-01.

l2Issues.name: Payment failed or declined
l2Issues.definition: A payment attempt fails.
l2Issues.useWhen: Card declined, bank blocks the first charge, method error, local method missing.
l2Issues.notThis: Payment succeeded but the plan did not change: BIL-05.

l2Issues.name: Paid but plan not active
l2Issues.definition: Payment succeeded but the plan or entitlement did not update.
l2Issues.useWhen: Charged and still on the old plan; an upgrade is stuck between payment and account.
l2Issues.notThis: Credits missing after a top-up: CRD-02.

l2Issues.name: Invoices & tax documents
l2Issues.definition: Needs an invoice, receipt, or tax document in the right form.
l2Issues.useWhen: Company name or tax ID missing, receipt history, regional format (VAT ID, GSTIN).
l2Issues.notThis: The amount charged is wrong: BIL-02.

l2Issues.name: Billing & renewal questions
l2Issues.definition: Question about renewal date, timing, or proration.
l2Issues.useWhen: When does my plan renew, in which time zone, what plan am I on.
l2Issues.notThis: Wants a discount for paying yearly: PLN-02.

l2Issues.name: Credits charged incorrectly
l2Issues.definition: Credits were deducted when they should not have been, or by the wrong amount.
l2Issues.useWhen: Failed generation charged, retry charged again, cancelled job charged, cost charged differs from cost shown, unexplained drop.
l2Issues.notThis: Unhappy with a completed result: CRD-05. Credits never arrived: CRD-02.

l2Issues.name: Credits missing or not applied
l2Issues.definition: Credits were expected and are not present.
l2Issues.useWhen: Top-up paid but balance unchanged, monthly reset did not fire, referral or promo credits absent.
l2Issues.notThis: Credits lost after a downgrade: CRD-04.

l2Issues.name: Balance mismatch
l2Issues.definition: Different balances shown on different surfaces.
l2Issues.useWhen: Phone and desktop disagree, two balances on one account.
l2Issues.notThis: The balance is simply lower than expected: CRD-01 or CRD-04.

l2Issues.name: Credits lost on plan change
l2Issues.definition: Credits disappeared after a downgrade or plan switch.
l2Issues.useWhen: Remaining credits expired when moving to a lower plan.
l2Issues.notThis: Credits lost for no plan-change reason: CRD-01.

l2Issues.name: Credit refund for a result
l2Issues.definition: Wants credits back for a completed generation.
l2Issues.useWhen: The job completed and the customer is unhappy with the output.
l2Issues.notThis: The job failed: CRD-01. Someone else used the account: PRV-02.

l2Issues.name: Credit policy & usage questions
l2Issues.definition: How credits work.
l2Issues.useWhen: Roll-over, expiry, cost per second, unlimited-plan counter, transfers.
l2Issues.notThis: Credits are missing: CRD-02.

l2Issues.name: Login or verification code not arriving
l2Issues.definition: Cannot log in because the emailed code or link does not arrive.
l2Issues.useWhen: Code or magic link never lands, spam checked, repeated attempts.
l2Issues.notThis: Password wrong or forgotten: ACC-02.

l2Issues.name: Password, 2FA & identity verification
l2Issues.definition: Reset a password or 2FA, or prove ownership.
l2Issues.useWhen: Wrong password, reset 2FA, enable 2FA, verify identity to recover an account.
l2Issues.notThis: Code not arriving: ACC-01.

l2Issues.name: Locked out, cause unknown
l2Issues.definition: Cannot access the account and no reason is shown.
l2Issues.useWhen: Login fails and the cause is not yet known. Reclassify once the cause is confirmed (TRS, PRV, ACC-01).
l2Issues.notThis: The reason is stated (dispute, suspension): TRS-03 or TRS-01.

l2Issues.name: Account changes
l2Issues.definition: Change email, username, or display name; merge accounts.
l2Issues.useWhen: Self-service changes and requests that need support.
l2Issues.notThis: Two accounts suspended together: TRS-01.

l2Issues.name: Sessions & device limits
l2Issues.definition: Unexpected logouts or device caps.
l2Issues.useWhen: Keeps logging me out, session ends early, device limit reached.
l2Issues.notThis: Cannot log in at all: ACC-01 to ACC-03.

l2Issues.name: Suspension & appeals
l2Issues.definition: Account suspended or banned; asks why or appeals.
l2Issues.useWhen: Suspension, ban, or appeal, including several accounts suspended together.
l2Issues.notThis: Locked because of a payment dispute: TRS-03.

l2Issues.name: Promo, referral & trial exploitation
l2Issues.definition: Complaint that a promo, referral, or trial workaround stopped working.
l2Issues.useWhen: Codes stopped stacking, self-referral stopped paying, a card is flagged as already associated.
l2Issues.notThis: A genuine question about eligibility: PLN-02.

l2Issues.name: Payment-dispute account lock
l2Issues.definition: Account locked because the customer opened a payment dispute; asks to unlock.
l2Issues.useWhen: Lock tied to a chargeback or payment review.
l2Issues.notThis: Locked for another stated reason: TRS-01.

l2Issues.name: Content policy & moderation
l2Issues.definition: Blocked prompt or output, or a policy notice.
l2Issues.useWhen: Prompt blocked, output flagged, content warning.
l2Issues.notThis: Account-level suspension: TRS-01.

l2Issues.name: Data deletion & access requests
l2Issues.definition: Wants the account or data deleted or exported.
l2Issues.useWhen: GDPR or CCPA style requests, close my account, erase my data.
l2Issues.notThis: Wants to cancel billing only: BIL-03.

l2Issues.name: Compromised account or unauthorized use
l2Issues.definition: Someone else used the account or payment method.
l2Issues.useWhen: Account taken over, family member used it, charges the customer did not make.
l2Issues.notThis: The customer made the generations and wants credits back: CRD-05.

l2Issues.name: Security disclosure
l2Issues.definition: Reports a vulnerability or security issue.
l2Issues.useWhen: Vulnerability, responsible disclosure.
l2Issues.notThis: A customer's own key pasted in a ticket is a flag (F-SEC), not this L2.

l2Issues.name: Licensing & commercial use
l2Issues.definition: Asks about rights to sell or monetize outputs.
l2Issues.useWhen: Can I sell it, license terms, commercial use.
l2Issues.notThis: Content policy block: TRS-04.

l2Issues.name: Compliance & legal requests
l2Issues.definition: Compliance paperwork or legal notices.
l2Issues.useWhen: DPA, security questionnaire, subpoena, tax exemption.
l2Issues.notThis: Data deletion: PRV-01.

l2Issues.name: Output quality
l2Issues.definition: Visual defects or wrong framing in a completed output.
l2Issues.useWhen: Blur, artifacts, color tint, cropping, preview differs from final.
l2Issues.notThis: The job did not complete: PRC-01.

l2Issues.name: Prompt adherence & controls
l2Issues.definition: Output ignores the prompt, or a needed control is missing.
l2Issues.useWhen: Ignored instructions, character limits, negative prompts, camera controls.
l2Issues.notThis: A request for a brand-new control: FBK-02.

l2Issues.name: Audio & lip-sync
l2Issues.definition: Audio missing or out of sync.
l2Issues.useWhen: No sound in the output or export, lip-sync delay.
l2Issues.notThis: Export fails entirely: PRC-02.

l2Issues.name: Watermark & branding
l2Issues.definition: Questions or complaints about the watermark or logo on outputs.
l2Issues.useWhen: Does it go away on upgrade, how to remove it.
l2Issues.notThis: Pricing opinion: PLN-01.

l2Issues.name: Generation stuck, queued, or failed
l2Issues.definition: A generation job does not complete.
l2Issues.useWhen: Stuck at a percentage, queued for hours, failed with an error.
l2Issues.notThis: An export that is stuck: PRC-02. If the customer's central ask is credits back, CRD-01 is primary and PRC-01 is secondary; if the stuck job is central and credits are only mentioned, PRC-01 is primary, CRD-01 is secondary, and F-MON is set.

l2Issues.name: Export problems
l2Issues.definition: An export job is stuck, fails, or produces the wrong file.
l2Issues.useWhen: Never finishes, wrong colors, no audio, wrong format.
l2Issues.notThis: "Can I export 4K at 24 fps?" is a capability question: FBK-01.

l2Issues.name: Upload problems
l2Issues.definition: Upload stuck or rejected.
l2Issues.useWhen: Stuck at 99%, file rejected, large file fails.
l2Issues.notThis: Export or generation issues: PRC-01 or PRC-02.

l2Issues.name: Sharing & links
l2Issues.definition: A shared link is broken, expired, or not found for others.
l2Issues.useWhen: Share link 404, not visible to recipients, expired.
l2Issues.notThis: Docs link broken: API-05.

l2Issues.name: Editor bugs & crashes
l2Issues.definition: Editor behaves incorrectly or crashes.
l2Issues.useWhen: Timeline, scrubber, clips snapping back, freezes, crashes.
l2Issues.notThis: Mobile-only issues: APP-02.

l2Issues.name: Mobile & tablet
l2Issues.definition: Problems specific to phone or tablet.
l2Issues.useWhen: Keyboard covers the prompt box, settings will not scroll, iPad behavior.
l2Issues.notThis: Same issue on desktop: APP-01.

l2Issues.name: Playback & preview
l2Issues.definition: Video will not play or preview fails.
l2Issues.useWhen: Black screen, will not play.
l2Issues.notThis: Preview differs from final output: GEN-01.

l2Issues.name: Projects & assets
l2Issues.definition: Recover, organize, or download projects and assets.
l2Issues.useWhen: Deleted a project by accident, folders, bulk download.
l2Issues.notThis: Request for a new organization feature: FBK-02.

l2Issues.name: Notifications & localization
l2Issues.definition: Existing settings for emails and interface language.
l2Issues.useWhen: Too many emails, how to change the interface language.
l2Issues.notThis: A new setting that does not exist (dark mode): FBK-02.

l2Issues.name: Keys & authentication
l2Issues.definition: Requests fail authentication or a key stops working.
l2Issues.useWhen: 401s, key disabled or revoked.
l2Issues.notThis: A rate limit: API-03.

l2Issues.name: Request errors
l2Issues.definition: Requests rejected as invalid.
l2Issues.useWhen: 400 responses, invalid parameters, a docs example that fails.
l2Issues.notThis: Authentication failure: API-01.

l2Issues.name: Rate limits & quotas
l2Issues.definition: Throttling or limit questions.
l2Issues.useWhen: 429s, throttled earlier than expected, wants a higher limit.
l2Issues.notThis: Authentication failure: API-01.

l2Issues.name: Webhooks & callbacks
l2Issues.definition: Webhooks do not arrive or retry.
l2Issues.useWhen: Not firing, retries, timeouts.
l2Issues.notThis: Request rejected before the job runs: API-02.

l2Issues.name: Docs, SDK & examples
l2Issues.definition: Documentation, SDK, or example problems.
l2Issues.useWhen: Docs example returns a different shape, SDK question, broken docs link.
l2Issues.notThis: A request that fails: API-02.

l2Issues.name: Members & seats
l2Issues.definition: Add or remove members and seats.
l2Issues.useWhen: Remove button greyed out, add seats, roles.
l2Issues.notThis: Shared credits and spend limits: WSP-02.

l2Issues.name: Shared credits & spend controls
l2Issues.definition: Workspace credits drained or no per-person limits.
l2Issues.useWhen: One member used the shared pool, asks for per-member caps, top-up for a team.
l2Issues.notThis: Individual balance issues: CRD-01 to CRD-04.

l2Issues.name: Enterprise account management
l2Issues.definition: Account manager, contract, or purchase-order matters.
l2Issues.useWhen: Account manager request, contract terms, PO.
l2Issues.notThis: A routine invoice: BIL-06.

l2Issues.name: SSO & provisioning
l2Issues.definition: Single sign-on and directory provisioning.
l2Issues.useWhen: SSO, SAML, SCIM setup.
l2Issues.notThis: Individual login issue: ACC-01 to ACC-03.

l2Issues.name: Collaboration & client review
l2Issues.definition: Commenting and client review needs.
l2Issues.useWhen: Clients cannot comment without an account, review links.
l2Issues.notThis: A partnership inquiry: NSP-02.

l2Issues.name: Pricing & value feedback
l2Issues.definition: Opinion that price or value is poor, often after cancelling.
l2Issues.useWhen: Overpriced, not worth it, "just cancelled, it is the pricing".
l2Issues.notThis: A request to cancel: BIL-03.

l2Issues.name: Discounts & eligibility
l2Issues.definition: Asks about a discount or whether they qualify.
l2Issues.useWhen: Student or education pricing, annual discount, nonprofit.
l2Issues.notThis: Exploit complaints: TRS-02.

l2Issues.name: Plan details & limits
l2Issues.definition: What a plan or the free tier includes.
l2Issues.useWhen: Free-tier credits, team plan, trial terms.
l2Issues.notThis: How credits are consumed: CRD-06.

l2Issues.name: Connectivity (site will not load)
l2Issues.definition: The site or app will not load on a particular network.
l2Issues.useWhen: Works on cellular, fails on home wifi, connection reset.
l2Issues.notThis: Site down for everyone: NET-02.

l2Issues.name: Outage & incident reports
l2Issues.definition: Site down or server errors.
l2Issues.useWhen: Site down, 500 errors, something went wrong.
l2Issues.notThis: Only fails on one network: NET-01.

l2Issues.name: Slow performance
l2Issues.definition: The product is slow.
l2Issues.useWhen: Laggy, slow to respond.
l2Issues.notThis: A job that never finishes: PRC-01.

l2Issues.name: How-to & capability questions
l2Issues.definition: Can I do X, how do I do X.
l2Issues.useWhen: Formats, frame rates, length, where a setting lives.
l2Issues.notThis: Something is broken: use the matching symptom L2. A how-to about a specific domain (cancel, add a member, change email) goes to that domain's L2 with intent set to question; FBK-01 is for general questions that fit no domain L2.

l2Issues.name: Feature requests
l2Issues.definition: Asks for something new.
l2Issues.useWhen: New controls, integrations, shortcuts, dark mode, per-member caps.
l2Issues.notThis: A bug in an existing feature: use the matching symptom L2.

l2Issues.name: Praise & no action needed
l2Issues.definition: Thanks, or the issue resolved itself.
l2Issues.useWhen: "it's fine now", thank you for fixing it.
l2Issues.notThis: Thanks followed by a new problem: classify the problem.

l2Issues.name: Careers & recruiting
l2Issues.definition: Job applications and recruiting messages.
l2Issues.useWhen: Resumes, openings, internships.
l2Issues.notThis: A customer asking about a job on the support team is still this.

l2Issues.name: Press, partnerships & affiliates
l2Issues.definition: Press, partnership, and affiliate or creator program inquiries.
l2Issues.useWhen: Press deadline, partnership, affiliate, creator program, sponsorship.
l2Issues.notThis: Client review feature requests: WSP-05.

l2Issues.name: Festival & Studios
l2Issues.definition: Film festival entries and status.
l2Issues.useWhen: Submission status, festival deadlines.
l2Issues.notThis: Product support questions.

l2Issues.name: Misdirected & spam
l2Issues.definition: Not about the product, or unsolicited sales.
l2Issues.useWhen: Wrong company, solicitation, SEO or lead-gen pitches.
l2Issues.notThis: Anything about the product.

l2Issues.name: Prompts typed into the support form
l2Issues.definition: A generation prompt typed into the support form.
l2Issues.useWhen: The message is only a prompt, with no question or problem.
l2Issues.notThis: An API customer pasting the failing request: API-02.

l2Issues.name: Sales leads
l2Issues.definition: Prospects asking for pricing or demos.
l2Issues.useWhen: Volume pricing, talk to sales.
l2Issues.notThis: Existing customers asking about plans: PLN-03.

l2Issues.name: Insufficient information
l2Issues.definition: No usable content, or a follow-up with no context.
l2Issues.useWhen: Blank message, "any update?", "help". Ask one question, then reclassify within one business day.
l2Issues.notThis: A follow-up on a classified thread inherits that thread's L2.

l2Issues.name: New-issue candidate
l2Issues.definition: Real content, but no L2 fits.
l2Issues.useWhen: Use sparingly. Every use is a candidate for the monthly taxonomy review.
l2Issues.notThis: Anything that fits an existing L2 even loosely.

l3Options.name: Zero-usage renewal
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Charged on renewal, no usage this cycle

l3Options.name: Accidental purchase or upgrade
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Customer did not mean to buy or change plan

l3Options.name: Service-failure refund
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: A failure on our side caused the loss

l3Options.name: Policy exception
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Outside the rules; needs a decision

l3Options.name: Pending authorization hold
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: One charge settled, one is a hold that drops off

l3Options.name: True duplicate
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Two settled charges for one purchase

l3Options.name: Charged after cancellation
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Cancel was not honored before renewal

l3Options.name: Unrecognized charge
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Customer cannot match it to a purchase

l3Options.name: Cannot find cancel
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Control exists but is not discoverable

l3Options.name: Cancel before renewal or trial end
Pause or hold
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Wants to keep the account but stop billing

l3Options.name: Bank blocks first charge
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: New-merchant block; retry or alternate method works

l3Options.name: Card rejected by region or 3DS
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Repeats for one region or issuer

l3Options.name: Missing company name or tax ID
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Details were not captured at checkout

l3Options.name: Receipt history
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Needs past receipts, billing page shows only the current one

l3Options.name: Regional format
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: VAT-ID, GSTIN, or local invoice rules

l3Options.name: Failed generation not refunded
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Refund did not trigger on task failure

l3Options.name: Charged for cancelled or queued job
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Debit taken for work that never ran

l3Options.name: Cost shown differs from cost charged
Unexplained deduction
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Balance dropped with no job to match

l3Options.name: Top-up not applied
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Payment settled, grant stuck in processing

l3Options.name: Monthly reset did not fire
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Renewal paid, credit grant job missed

l3Options.name: Plan-upgrade grant missing
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Upgrade settled, new allowance not granted

l3Options.name: Accidental generations
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Pet, child, or misclick queued jobs

l3Options.name: Email provider not delivering
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Concentrated on one mail domain; record the domain

l3Options.name: Identity verification requested
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Needs a secure verification flow, never a ticket

l3Options.name: Color cast or tint
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Sudden color shift; check for a regression if clustered

l3Options.name: Cropping or aspect
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Frame does not match the request

l3Options.name: Key revoked after owner password reset
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Reset invalidates keys; send a notice

l3Options.name: Removed from workspace
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Key belongs to a workspace the user left

l3Options.name: Parameter type or format
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: String where an integer is expected

l3Options.name: Unsupported value
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Value outside what the model allows

l3Options.name: Limit is per workspace, not per key
Customer endpoint slow
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Timeouts on their side; return fast, process async

l3Options.name: Known router or DNS filter
l3Options.distinguishingEvidence: Record the router model; known blocklist behavior

riskFlags.meaning: Secret, ID document, card number, or password pasted in the ticket
riskFlags.suggestedHandling: Redact, rotate, and warn the customer. Raises priority to P1.

riskFlags.meaning: Money-touching: a refund or credit grant may be needed
riskFlags.suggestedHandling: Needs guardrails before any automatic action: per-action cap, frequency limit, audit trail, human approval until validated

riskFlags.meaning: Chargeback or dispute threatened or open
riskFlags.suggestedHandling: Route to Risk before any refund decision

riskFlags.meaning: Suspected exploitation of a policy or promo
riskFlags.suggestedHandling: Firm macro; do not escalate to engineering

riskFlags.meaning: Regional or tax requirement (VAT ID, GSTIN, GDPR region)
riskFlags.suggestedHandling: Regional template; legal check where needed

riskFlags.meaning: Possible incident: unusual volume on one L2 within an hour
riskFlags.suggestedHandling: Page the owner; open an incident note
Feed to VOC for Product and Growth
